legibilitySensitive:true is honestly satisfiable here: caa-revalidation is not one of the three grandfathered families, so its excluded-substrates list (dao-descendant, trading-reconciliation-recompute, deployment-rollback-recompute — all excluded for exactly this operator, per data/phase-21-operators.json) does not apply.

The operator's own priorEvidence names a direct, concrete anchor: 'tasks/caa-revalidation-repair/task.toml (difficulty_explanation already documents one step of exactly this property)' — the mispaired-identity defect this whole family models already carries one step of causal indirection (a wrong query at one point, a wrong bound answer used in the issuance decision at another). This operator's constructionDelta asks for exactly one MORE step: a decision made in one scenario whose consequence surfaces in a later, otherwise-unrelated scenario, rather than within the same evaluation.

This directly and honestly resolves a gap Phase 22 itself flagged and explicitly declined to fabricate a mutant for: 'This family has no cache-mutation or write-back path at all... Inventing a mutant for a mechanism the substrate does not have would be exactly the fabrication this phase exists to avoid.' Phase 23's causal-depth operator is the deliberate, motivated vehicle for actually adding that mechanism as a genuine one-step deepening — not a throwaway mutant, a real construction change with its own frozen baseline/treated pair.

Deep familiarity with this family from Phase 22 (reference.ts was extended there; truth.ts/scenarios.ts/verify.ts/mutants.ts were all read and reasoned about in full) reduces the risk of a subtle construction error relative to building on a less-familiar family in the same phase.

lane2CausalDepthInfeasibilityFinding.status: BLOCKED-BEFORE-MEASUREMENT — causal-depth is NOT constructible on caa-revalidation without editing verify.ts, which staysFixed forbids. Recorded as a real finding, not silently abandoned.
lane2CausalDepthInfeasibilityFinding.attemptedConstruction: The operator's own priorEvidence points to tasks/caa-revalidation-repair/task.toml's difficulty_explanation, read in full this phase: the real (Go-based, terminal-bench) task's actual mechanism is a mispaired revalidation answer WRITTEN BACK into a persistent store, whose damage 'is one order removed from its cause' because 'an order arriving inside the freshness window is then decided from an authorization belonging to a different domain.' Attempting the direct analogue on src/families/caa-revalidation/ (linked order pairs sharing one fqdn, the first order's reported answer written back as the second order's cachedCaa) requires the SECOND order to present the carried name as fresh — a stale-presented name is rechecked against independent truth regardless of what the first order did, so no propagation is even possible through a stale name.
lane2CausalDepthInfeasibilityFinding.proof: src/families/caa-revalidation/truth.ts#applicableAnswer defines, verbatim: isStale(view, name) ? scenario.current[name.fqdn] : name.cachedCaa. For any FRESH name, the applicable answer IS the cache by definition. verify.ts#L115 (caa_applicable_answer) checks resultFor(name.fqdn)?.caa !== applicable[index] — for a fresh name this reduces to checking the report's value against the cache itself, so a subject that reports the cache verbatim (right or wrong) always passes, no matter what value a scenario constructor puts in that cache. This is not a limitation of construction cleverness; it is a structural consequence of the spec's own definition (fresh cache is trusted, full stop — the entire point of a recheck window). No scenarios/truth-only construction (verify.ts and types.ts held fixed, per shapeFieldsEdited) can make a poisoned-but-fresh cache detectable.
lane2CausalDepthInfeasibilityFinding.consequence: Pivoting Lane 2's selection to the pre-identified, pre-registered alternative: diagnosis-radius on prompt-injection-memory-poisoning. This is a disciplined pivot to an alternative already named and reasoned about BEFORE any construction began (see agentFacingConstructionInterventions above), not an undisciplined search for whichever operator happens to work — causal-depth's infeasibility is recorded as a genuine result, not erased.
